command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const os=require('os');const h=os.homedir();const statePath=path.join(h,'workspace/bundles/hooks/state/brief_auto_exec.json');let m={};try{if(fs.existsSync(statePath)) m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(statePath,'utf8'))}catch(e){};let manifestVer='unknown';try{manifestVer=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(h,'workspace/bundles/manifest.json'),'utf8')).version||'unknown'}catch(e){};const stale=Date.now()-new Date(m.last_run||m.lastRun||0).getTime()>15*60*1000;const mismatch=m.last_slug!==manifestVer;console.log('[podcast_brief_watchdog] validation manifest latest ['+manifestVer+'] != state last_slug ['+(m.last_slug||'none')+'] mismatch='+mismatch+' stale>15m='+stale+' ageMs='+(Date.now()-new Date(m.last_run||0).getTime()));if((mismatch&&m.last_slug)||stale||!m.last_run){console.log('STALE wake needed — manifest latest != state last_slug or stale>15m');process.exit(2)}else{console.log('fresh')}" || echo "[watchdog] stale detected, poll may need restart — manifest latest != state last_slug validation triggered"
description: Check podcast_brief_auto_exec hook — if manifest latest != state last_slug, it already wakes, but if stale >15m ensure poll still alive — validates manifest latest != state last_slug
